newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Gandalf up in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Gandalf up in heavy trade.

text.p: Canada's Gandalf Technologies Inc surged in heavy trade Tuesday to highlight the market in American Depositary Receipts and foreign shares.
Gandalf, a data communications equipment company, rose 1-3/8, or 135 percent, to 2-3/8 ahead of first quarter results scheduled for release Wednesday.

Volume in late morning was five million shares, more than 10 times normal daily trade, and Gandalf was among the most active stocks on the Nasdaq. The shares have been battered recently, falling from a 12-month high of 19-1/2.

Britain's top three drug stocks jumped to 12-month highs. Glaxo Wellcome Plc rose 1-1/4 to 40-3/4, SmithKline Beecham Plc was up 1-7/8 to 86-3/4 on heavy volume, and Zeneca Group Plc rose 1-1/2 to 96.
Philips Electronics NV rose 3/8 to 56 after Goldman Sachs raised its rating on the Dutch compay to trading buy from market outperformer.
Among Latin American ADRs, Brazilian telephone company
Decliners led advancers 238 to 205 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group was off 0.10 percent and volume was 34 million shares.
